name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras.

All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial.

It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.
narrative.objectives: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.
narrative.offerRewardText: Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of a Azerothian cat spirit.Let us begin.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 20, 2,875 XP in all.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

quests.name: The Great Windborne Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

quests.name: The Great Cat Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Great Cat Spirit.

To Thunder Bluff
